purpose: Open ordinary MATHSOLVE pull requests for already-created GCL-ERDOS3 silent-lease expiry reconciliation branches. The controller validates lifecycle-only state and has no authority to write branches, merge, adjudicate mathematics, or promote frontier claims.
authority_source: existing GCL Release Trust GitHub App installation; short-lived per-run token only
allowed_actions: read protected MATHSOLVE main and registered lease-expiry branches
compare an expiry branch against protected main
validate exact dispatch, lease epoch, activation receipt, expiry timestamps, and zero-return state
open a pull request from an existing validated lease-expiry branch to main
prohibited_actions: modify campaign state outside the already-created candidate branch
promote a theorem or frontier node
claim certification or canonical mathematical effect
use administration, actions-write, checks-write, issues-write, or workflow-write authority

wake.kind: shared External intake PR controller GitHub Actions job
